sections.heading: Profile
sections.text:
Software engineer working on AI agents, retrieval systems and reproducible evaluation. Currently pursuing an M.Tech. in Software Engineering at the National University of Singapore. I build systems that turn model outputs into controlled, executable actions, then measure how well they work.

I studied Computer Science at KAIST before joining NUS. My experience spans enterprise agents, industrial computer vision and Java Web development.

My independent projects explore coding agents built from first principles, multi-path retrieval and context management. Controlled experiments, including negative results, guide the design.

From Java Web development to industrial vision and enterprise agents, my focus has remained on execution boundaries, real-world performance and reproducible evidence.

sections.heading: Skills
sections.text:
Programming: Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, C++, SQL

Agents & LLMs: Planner–executor runtimes, tool use, memory and context, multi-agent systems, MCP, LangGraph

Retrieval: Hybrid full-text, dense-vector and graph retrieval; query understanding, score fusion, context assembly and KV-cache reuse

Evaluation: Evaluation-set design, ranking metrics, ablations, parameter search, load and adversarial testing

Distributed systems: Python services, async task pipelines and queues, SSE streaming, role-based isolation and CI

Data: MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, SQLite, MinIO, Chroma; schema profiling and ingestion pipelines

Computer vision: Object detection, pose estimation, graph neural networks and GPU inference deployment

Languages: Mandarin (native), English (TOEFL 90), Korean (TOPIK Level 2)
